title: COMSOL connection and validation
content: COMSOL 连接成功、模型树读回和科学验证分别记录。Connection, model readback and scientific validation require separate evidence for each run.

title: MATLAB PDE Toolbox thermal boundary
content: MATLAB 的传热有限元任务需要 PDE Toolbox。热边界应按几何位置核对，并与解析解比较。Thermal boundary selection and analytical temperature checks are independent of process exit.

title: VASP electronic and ionic convergence
content: VASP 电子自洽收敛与离子优化收敛是不同判据。NSW 为零的单点计算无需离子优化收敛，但仍需电子自洽证据。Electronic convergence and ionic convergence are separate checks.

title: Materials Studio module selection
content: Materials Studio 的 Forcite、CASTEP 和 DMol3 属于不同计算模块。模块、输入模型、力场或电子结构设置应分别确认。Forcite molecular simulation and CASTEP or DMol3 electronic structure require separate module contracts.

title: LAMMPS compute msd and diffusion
content: LAMMPS compute msd 使用包含周期穿越的位移计算均方位移。MSD 对时间的线性拟合需要先判断扩散区间。Mean squared displacement uses unwrapped coordinates; a linear fit alone does not validate a diffusion coefficient.

title: LAMMPS thermo output completion
content: LAMMPS thermo 的输出频率不等于采样充分性。运行开始和结束也会输出热力学记录，完成检查应核对请求的最终步数。Thermodynamic output and completed timesteps do not establish equilibration.

title: Mathics3 symbolic calculation
content: Mathics3 可用于符号表达式计算；运算返回值、数值检查与科学结论分别记录。Mathics3 symbolic calculation does not imply complete Mathematica compatibility.

title: Scientific assumptions and source evidence
content: 来源可定位、参数使用授权和科学验证是不同状态。缺少参数时可提出带适用范围的候选假设；假设不会因此成为已验证事实。Source location, assumption authorization and scientific validation remain distinct.
